features.title: Add trace_id/span_id correlation fields to OCSF event builders
acceptance: OCSF events emitted inside a sampled OTel span include trace.uid (32 lowercase hex characters) and list trace in metadata.profiles
OCSF events emitted without an active sampled span omit the trace object and do not list the profile
The Trace profile schema is vendored and schema validation tests cover events with and without trace
